title: goniophlebium cyathoides
intro: Goniophlebium cyathoides, commonly known as the 'Cup-shaped Lip Fern', is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Goniophlebium cyathoides are attributed to its ability to reduce oxidative stress, modulate the immune system, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
